headline: A clearer Home for your references
summary: Browse larger previews in a redesigned Classic library, move smoothly through Focus Flow, and jump straight to a saved board's folder.

new.title: Show a board in its folder
new.description: Use the folder icon beside a saved board's actions on Home to reveal its original file in Explorer. Available in both Classic Grid and Focus Flow.

new.title: Switch layouts from Home
new.description: Move between Grid and Flow with the layout buttons in the header. Your search stays in place, and RefBoard remembers your choice.

improved.title: A redesigned Classic library
improved.description: Larger, uncropped previews and clearer titles sit on a clean, neutral background. A compact header and simpler cards keep the attention on your boards.

improved.title: A lighter Focus Flow
improved.description: Bigger landscape previews, titles beneath the cards, and a simpler thumbnail row make browsing easier. The boxed dock, extra scrubber bar, and redundant text are gone.

improved.title: Cards follow your drag
improved.description: Large Flow cards track the pointer directly and settle smoothly. Wheel and keyboard browsing remain available, with motion reduced when your system requests it.

fixed.title: Steadier previews while browsing
fixed.description: Cards fade smoothly at the edge of Flow, and unchanged previews stay in place when Home refreshes. Card actions remain stable as you move between boards.

fixed.title: A better fit in smaller windows
fixed.description: Home's header, card controls, and empty states adapt to compact windows without overlapping. Long board titles stay contained within their cards.
